housing: Minneapolis rentals include brick walk-up apartment buildings, duplexes, older wood-frame houses and new apartment buildings downtown and in Uptown.

localRules.text: Most Minneapolis rentals need a city rental license, and owners must give tenants a copy of the license certificate.
Minneapolis limits security deposits to no more than one month's rent.

tenantHelp.name: City of Minneapolis renter rights
tenantHelp.what: city information and protections for renters

climate: Long, cold winters mean you should test the heat, check windows and doors for drafts, and photograph ice dams, frost damage or water stains on ceilings.
fact: If a Minneapolis rental license is revoked and tenants have to move out, the owner must pay relocation assistance.
